title: The 9/11 '4,000 Absentees' Myth Erases Real People
hero_object: Bronze Inscriptions of the National 9/11 Memorial & Museum Wall of Names
punchline: Before you repeat the rumor, remember the people it erases.
visual_paradigm: Solemn Memorial Bronze & Forensic Verification (Graphite Black #111827, Memorial Bronze #D97706, Pure White #FFFFFF)

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: This nine-eleven rumor erases real people.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Within days of the September eleventh attacks, a viral story began spreading: that four thousand Jewish workers stayed home because they were secretly warned.
scenes.on_screen: THE MYTH: 4,000 STAYED HOME WITH ADVANCE WARNING

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Where did the number come from? A misquoted news report that four thousand Israeli citizens were in the New York metropolitan area on any given day.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: And the claim is sickeningly false. The victims list at the World Trade Center includes hundreds of Jewish workers, traders, first responders, and visitors whose lives and deaths are documented.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Families held funerals. Colleagues mourned partners. A conspiracy theory took a tragedy that affected all backgrounds and tried to exploit human grief.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Fact-checking isn’t just about debunking falsehoods. It’s about honoring the truth of innocent human lives.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.text: Before you repeat the rumor, remember the people it erases.
scenes.source: Beyond the Myth · Facts, not scapegoats
